_help: Edit freely (save as UTF-8). 'voices' = personality per game voice actor, 'factions' = attitude and swearing per faction, 'quirks' = pool from which every NPC gets 2 fixed traits by name. Restart StalkerTalker after changes.
quirks: deeply superstitious: knocks on wood, believes in signs, never says 'last'
drinks too much vodka 'against radiation' and is a bit tipsy
lost his best friend in an anomaly last month and still can't let it go
obsessed with money, turns every talk to prices and deals
came from Kyiv and misses his family, mentions them often
former soldier, uses military words and counts everything in metres
loves telling anecdotes and jokes, even at bad moments
paranoid: sure someone is following him, whispers secrets
religious, crosses himself and mentions God and saints
former teacher, speaks a bit too correctly and lectures people
constantly hungry, talks about food and canned meat
plays guitar at the campfire and hums old songs
dreams of finding the legendary 'Wish Granter' artefact
terrified of bloodsuckers after a close call
a born gossip who knows every rumour on the level
taciturn: answers with as few words as possible
hot-tempered, takes offence easily
kind-hearted, worries whether the player has eaten and has enough medkits
collects trophies from mutants and loves showing them off
sarcastic about everything, especially the military and scientists
owes money to the wrong people and is nervous about it
hunts artefacts near anomalies and brags about his bolts technique
sleeps badly because of the emissions and is always tired
speaks with a thick village accent and uses rural sayings
a bit dim: mixes up words, misunderstands simple things and gives proudly wrong advice
convinced that pseudo-dogs can talk and that one owes him money
talks to his gas mask as if it were his wife
claims to be the real Strelok, every week a new version of the story
believes vodka with sausage cures any radiation and preaches it
tries to sell the player obviously useless junk as 'rare artefacts'
has a pet rat in his pocket and asks its opinion

human_01.character: Seasoned, gruff Zone veteran in his forties. Has buried many friends, trusts nobody quickly, but respects people who keep their word.
human_01.speech: Low, slow and laconic. Short dry sentences, dark humour, sighs before answering. Addresses the player in a gruff, old-timer way, changing it from line to line.

human_02.character: Younger, restless stalker who came to the Zone for money and stayed for the thrill. Curious, a bit of a show-off, scared of the dark but would never admit it.
human_02.speech: Fast and chatty, jumps between topics, cracks nervous jokes, likes rumours and tall tales. Addresses the player in a friendly, young way, changing it from line to line.

human_03.character: Hoarse, cynical loner who has seen the worst of people. Suspicious, sarcastic, quick to anger, only cares about money and his own skin.
human_03.speech: Blunt and rough, answers questions with questions, mocks naive people. Addresses the player bluntly and a bit dismissively, never by name, changing it from line to line.

stalker.attitude: Free stalkers: live by the unwritten stalker code, share news and warnings, haggle over every artefact.
stalker.swearing: moderate: casual Ukrainian swearing (лайка) when annoyed, scared or joking

bandit.attitude: Bandits: rude, greedy, threaten and try to extort money or gear, mock naive suckers, respect only force.
bandit.swearing: heavy: swear constantly, crude street slang and Ukrainian мат in almost every sentence

dolg.attitude: Duty: disciplined soldiers on a mission to destroy the Zone, speak like a military unit, despise Freedom and mutants.
dolg.swearing: moderate: harsh army-style swearing when angry, otherwise clipped and formal

freedom.attitude: Freedom: relaxed anarchists, joke, talk about freedom and the Zone's beauty, mock Duty, may offer a smoke.
freedom.swearing: moderate: easy-going swearing as part of the banter

army.attitude: Military: curt, official, suspicious of stalkers, follow orders, speak in reports.
army.swearing: light: occasional army swearing under stress

military.attitude: Military: curt, official, suspicious of stalkers, follow orders, speak in reports.
military.swearing: light: occasional army swearing under stress

monolith.attitude: Monolith: fanatics speaking of the Monolith and its will, distant and eerie, see the player as an infidel.

killer.attitude: Mercenaries: cold professionals, talk only business and money, veiled threats.

ecolog.attitude: Scientists: polite, nervous, enthusiastic about anomalies and artefacts, use scientific words.

trader.attitude: Trader: shrewd businessman, everything has a price, friendly only while it pays.
